title: On The Go Repairs
description:
One of the big benefits of smithing a tool this way is repairability. Where your regular tools shatter into pieces at the end of their lifespan, these tools will simply fall into a broken state. You'll be able ta repair them whenever ya get the chance and they'll be good as new.
But I hear you. Maybe ya don' got an anvil without you while yer out in the wild. Well, that's when you'll want a Repair Kit. There's a few variants, each able to store more material and repair items more efficiently, the highest tier of Azure being as good as a proper anvil. For now, [a cruder kit](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/repair_kits.png:124:62:2:1000) will do the trick jus' fine.
Once you make one, you can fill it with material in a crafting table. Jus' put the materials in the grid, as much as you'd like. And to empty it, put a stick in the grid instead. But be warned thatcha may not get yer materials back from this.
